panels.burned_in_description: Partly cut-off, illegible header text along the top edge that may be exam or record header text; plus ultrasound scanner brand, model and setting text
panels.notes: Viewed at original and enlarged size. The top-edge strip holds only cut-off letter fragments that cannot be read, so whether it carries a name, record number or date is unknown; flagged conservatively as direct identifiers. Scanner brand, model and settings and a printed side label are device text. No face or sensitive anatomy.
